subject.title: ci: add unsigned iOS build workflow

question: Should OpenClaw core adopt an unsigned iOS `.xcarchive` GitHub Actions lane after the workflow is hardened?
rationale: The remaining code fixes are mechanical, but owning a downloadable unsigned app archive as first-party CI output is an infrastructure/product decision.

options.title: Harden And Adopt
options.body: Fix the input and token issues, rerun the workflow, and keep the unsigned archive lane as maintainer-owned CI output.

options.title: Keep It External
options.body: Leave the fork workflow as external proof and close this PR if maintainers do not want core to publish unsigned iOS archives.

options.title: Defer To iOS Release Planning
options.body: Pause this PR until the iOS release owners define a broader unsigned/TestFlight/local-install distribution plan.

recommendation.title: Harden And Adopt
recommendation.body: Fix the input and token issues, rerun the workflow, and keep the unsigned archive lane as maintainer-owned CI output.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision is primarily about CI security and workflow ownership, where recent history points most strongly to vincentkoc.
